text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Several days have passed since the<n>spring Tenno
Sho.

Tamamo Cross regrets provoking<n>Super Creek with
her<n>unsportsmanlike remarks.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Hearing this, I learn that Tamamo<n>Cross had ignited
Super Creek's<n>fervor by threatening to hurt me.

I hope that Super Creek is able to run<n>her next race
with a calm mind and<n>peaceful heart.
